description: Will buyer agents pick my x402 API for one task? The single-task panel is the Machine Buyer Panel for buyers under a dollar cap: buyer-agent models choose between your offer and its real Bazaar rivals for one task, across personas and list positions. Returns your win rate with confidence intervals, why you lost, and the proof arm (does a Fair Offer block or an attested sample lift your pick rate). No drafted edits; the full panel tests those. Price: $0.25 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.25 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
